candidates.title: G-Algebras and Modular Representation Theory
candidates.summary: This book presents a new approach to the modular representation theory of a finite group G. Its aim is to provide a comprehensive treatment of the theory of G-algebras and to show how this theory is used to solve various problems in representation theory. Significant results have been obtained by means of this approach, which also sheds new light on modular representation theory. So it appears that a need has arisen for an expository book on the subject. I hope to meet this need and to introduce a wider audience to these new ideas.

candidates.title: Nonsolvable critical groups with the spectrum of $S_{10}$
candidates.summary: We classify the nonsolvable finite groups that are critical with respect to the spectrum of the symmetric group $S_{10}$. Up to isomorphism, there are exactly two such groups: $S_{10}$ and $(A_9\times C_3)\rtimes C_2$, where the involution acts on $A_9$ by conjugation by a transposition and on $C_3$ by inversion. The quotient of any nonsolvable group with this spectrum by its solvable radical is almost simple. All possible simple socles are treated without assuming that the radical is nilpotent. The final cases, $L_3(4)$ and $A_6$, are excluded using the canonical subgroup $K=[R(G)\cap G^\infty,G^\infty]$, actions on chief factors, and the required element orders $9,20,30$. In the $A_6$ case, the final contradiction is the existence of an element of order $16$. Reproducible certificates accompany the character-table and matrix calculations.

candidates.summary: We show that for nonconjugate subgroups and of a finite group , there exists an extension of (by a finite group) in which the preimages of and are not isomorphic. This allows us to show that ‐coset equivalent subgroups of a finite group are not necessarily isomorphic, answering a question of Dipendra Prasad. We also indicate connections to profinite rigidity, anabelian geometry, mapping class groups, and nonarithmetic lattices in Lie groups.

candidates.title: On primes not adjacent to $2$ in the prime graphs of almost simple groups
candidates.summary: The prime graph $GK(G)$ of a finite group $G$ is the graph whose vertices are primes dividing the order of $G$ and in which two distinct primes $r$ and $s$ are adjacent if and only if $G$ has an element of order $rs$. The $2$-independence number of $GK(G)$ is the maximal size of independent vertex subsets in $GK(G)$ containing the vertex~$2$. We determine all almost simple groups whose prime graph has a vertex $r$ not adjacent to $2$ and find the $2$-independence numbers of all almost simple groups.

candidates.title: Dyson's Tenfold Way, Revisited
candidates.summary: In this work, we study semilinear representations of groups acting on degree two Galois extensions. Our results include a classification of irreducible semilinear representations, which generalises Dyson's Tenfold Way. Using this, we completely describe the semilinear representation theory of certain groups, such as symmetric groups, and of finite groups over cyclotomic fields. We also prove many results concerning semilinear representations over $\mathbb{C}$, which includes an induction theorem which simultaneously generalises Brauer's Induction Theorem and Serre's Induction Theorem. We are also interested in applications of our classification theorem to crystallography, and include a detailed study of the semilinear representation theory of magnetic wallpaper groups.
